text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Paul Brandeis said he initiated coverage of Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc with outperform.
-- The 1996 earnings per share estimate is $0.70 and 1997 EPS is $0.80.
-- Further details were not immediately available.

-- Brandeis later said in a research note that Rofin-Sinar had about 20 percent of the worldwide industrial laser market for cutting and wielding and was a leader in laser marketing in Europea and Asia/Pacific, excluding Japan.

"We expected the material processiong industrial labor market to grow 7-10 percent through the end of the decade," Brandeis said. "We believe that Rofin will be able to grow earnings in the 15-20 percent range thorugh the end of the decade on its ability to take market share through new technology and applications development."
